  acceptString("\(x)")
case .Payload((let x)):

case .Payload(inout x):
  acceptInt(x)
case .Payload(_mutating x):
  acceptInt(x)
case .Payload(_borrowing x):
  acceptInt(x)
case .Payload(_consuming x):
